description: Protocol v1 section 23. `playErrors`: a StandardIntegrityErrorCode integer to the action. `appAttestErrors`: a DCError.Code case name to the action. `responses`: an HTTP response of /v1/challenge or /v1/solve (body is UTF-8 text, or bodyBase64 for bytes) to the SDK outcome. `sdkErrorCodes`: every code an SDK reports (MOBILE_SDK_ERRORS, in order); `apiErrorCodes`: the API codes it passes through from an error body (API_ERROR_CODES). Layout differs from section 12 (three groups and two code lists instead of `cases`).

appAttestErrors.name: serverUnavailable: keep the key, send unavailable
invalidKey: drop the key and attest again once
featureUnsupported: drop the key, DeviceCheck fallback
invalidInput: drop the key, unavailable internal
unknownSystemFailure: drop the key, unavailable internal
an error that is not a DCError: drop the key, unavailable internal
a DCError case added by a later OS: drop the key, unavailable internal

responses.name: solve 200 token with an unknown field
solve 200 token with an unknown attestation value
solve 200 puzzle with attestation reattest (an escalated app solve)
solve 200 puzzle with an empty attestation
solve 429 Retry-After as an HTTP date is ignored
solve 400 error body without a code
solve 400 error body with a duplicate key
solve 200 byte-order mark inside the type key
solve 200 escaped byte-order mark inside the type key
solve 200 byte-order mark inside the token
solve 200 escaped byte-order mark inside the token
solve 200 a key with a byte-order mark beside type is not a duplicate
challenge 200 an unknown key with a byte-order mark is tolerated
